data.title: Mirage The Oasis
data.about:
Discover your dream home at Mirage The Oasis, a dazzling new venture by Emaar Properties, nestled in the vibrant heart of Dubai. This luxurious residential community sets a new standard for upscale living with its stunning collection of 5 & 6-bedroom waterfront villas. 

At Mirage The Oasis, tranquility meets metropolitan sophistication, offering a unique lifestyle amidst lush waterways and leisure spaces. Every villa in Mirage The Oasis Dubai exudes a distinctive charm, with 3 villa styles to choose from: Classic, Contemporary, and Chamfered. These designs are the epitome of elegance, promising a living space that's both grand and welcoming. Mirage by Emaar isn't just about the homes—it's about creating a lifestyle that's enriched with the finest amenities. Picture yourself in expansive living spaces that open up to terraces and rooftop gardens, perfect for those who adore the outdoors and entertaining guests.

Immerse yourself in the luxury and serenity of Mirage The Oasis, where every detail is crafted with precision to offer an unparalleled living experience. Welcome to Mirage by Emaar—where dreams of luxurious living become reality.

characteristics_module.title: A Vision of Wellness & Elegance at Mirage The Oasis
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Luxurious Waterfront Villas: Offers exclusive 5 & 6-bedroom villas in Dubai, set against a backdrop of serene waterways.
  • Sophisticated Villa Styles: Choose from 3 villa styles - Classic, Contemporary, and Chamfered, each reflecting elegance and charm.
  • Waterfront Views: Enjoy stunning views of tranquil waterways directly from nearly every residence.
  • Outdoor Living: Features flat-style layouts with terraces and rooftop spaces ideal for sky gardens and outdoor entertainment.
  • Amenities Galore: Access to swimmable lagoons, lush landscapes, a fitness center, children's playground, and a multipurpose room enhances the living experience.
  • Linear Park Access: Offers a variety of recreational facilities within the community for a balanced lifestyle.
  • Strategic Location: Situated in a thriving area of Dubai, ensuring easy connectivity to major roads and destinations.
  • Flexible Payment Plans: Simple payment options are available to facilitate your home buying process.

location_tile.title: Mirage at The Oasis : Luxury Villas Surrounded by Nature
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Nestled in the heart of Dubailand, Mirage at The Oasis is perfectly situated with convenient access to both Yalayis Street/Jebel Ali-Al Hibab Road and Sheikh Zayed Bin Hamdan Al Nahyan Street. This premium residential community offers the ultimate in strategic living, ensuring that residents are just a short drive away from Dubai's bustling business hubs, renowned shopping centers, vibrant entertainment spots, and top-tier educational facilities.

Mirage The Oasis epitomizes the ideal balance between the hustle of city life and the tranquil embrace of nature, making it a coveted location for those seeking the best of both worlds in Dubai.

  • 18 minutes to Al Maktoum International Airport
  • 20 minutes to Dubai Hills Estate, Dubai Hills Mall & Dubai Hills Golf course
  • 28 minutes to Dubai Marina & Dubai Marina Mall
  • 35 minutes to Downtown Dubai & Dubai Mall
